# Memgraph

> Memgraph is a high-performance in-memory graph database with AI integration, vector search, and GraphRAG capabilities for real-time analytics and intelligent applications.

Memgraph provides an open-source, ACID-compliant graph database platform with 8x faster performance than Neo4j, comprehensive tooling including Lab visualization and natural language querying, and deep integration with LLMs for building context-aware AI applications. The platform serves enterprises across fraud detection, cybersecurity, knowledge graphs, and recommendation systems.
